name: cooperative_pooling_forms
title: Cooperative pooling forms — feature coding
description: PROVISIONAL / PARTLY ASSISTANT-CODED seed dataset. A morphological coding of arrangements whose primary function is mutualising a hazard across a membership — rotating credit associations, general average, communal levies, confraternity and burial funds, tontines — as distinct from the capital-holding vehicles coded in organizational_forms. Stored long/tidy: one row per form x characteristic. Supports Objective 1 (the management of 'loss') and carries the same WP1 component vocabulary as organizational_forms, so the two packages join at component level. Codes live in vocabularies/cooperative_pooling_type.csv and vocabularies/cooperative_pooling_characteristic.csv. Rows with coder 'ai' are provisional seed codings pending human verification; source_ref '[verify]' marks a value asserted pending a pinned reference.

fields.name: record_id
fields.title: Record ID
fields.description: Stable unique identifier for the coding. Never reused.

fields.name: type_id
fields.title: Pooling form (coded)
fields.description: Coded pooling arrangement. Controlled vocabulary: vocabularies/cooperative_pooling_type.csv. Not enum-constrained here because the census is still growing (CONTRIBUTING §5).

fields.name: char_id
fields.title: Characteristic (coded)
fields.description: Coded structural characteristic. Controlled vocabulary: vocabularies/cooperative_pooling_characteristic.csv, which also gives each characteristic's value type, allowed values, and WP1 component.

fields.name: value
fields.title: Coded state
fields.description: The characteristic's state for this form. Ternary characteristics: 1 present, P partial, 0 absent. Nominal characteristics: one of that characteristic's allowed categories. Absence (0) is a datum, kept distinct from .NA (inapplicable) and .NR (not yet coded).

fields.name: confidence
fields.title: Record confidence
fields.description: Confidence in the coding. Orthogonal to value.

fields.name: articulation
fields.title: Articulation
fields.description: Whether the coded function was articulated by the tradition's own advocates in their own idiom ('articulated'), or is visible only under the analyst's description ('analyst-imposed'). '.NR' where not yet assessed; propagates '.NA' with the value. 'articulated' must never rest on a placeholder citation.

fields.name: source_ref
fields.title: Source reference
fields.description: Short citation supporting the coding, or '[verify]' where the value is asserted pending a pinned reference.

fields.name: source_lang
fields.title: Source language
fields.description: Language of source_ref. ISO 639-1 where a two-letter code exists, otherwise ISO 639-3.

fields.name: coder
fields.title: Coder
fields.description: Initials of the team member who entered the record. 'ai' marks a provisional assistant-generated seed coding pending human verification.

fields.name: notes
fields.title: Notes
fields.description: Free-text coder note: rationale, the school that dissents, caveats, cross-references.
